methods.label: Magic kill and book bomb
methods.summary: Use magic against Crazy archaeologist and move away from the book-bomb special attack.
prayers: Protect from Missiles or Magic depending setup
steps: Attack with magic because the boss has low magic defence.
When he announces his book attack, move away from the targeted tile before it lands.
Keep health high enough to survive mistakes and Wilderness interruptions.
Loot quickly and reset if another player enters the area.
risks: The book-bomb special can stack heavy damage.
The Wilderness location creates player-killer risk.

methods.label: Low-risk Wilderness trip
methods.summary: Use inexpensive magic gear and short trips to control Wilderness losses.
recommendedFor: collection log or rune crossbow attempts
steps: Risk only the gear needed to keep kills consistent.
Bring enough food for book-bomb mistakes and player interruptions.
Bank valuable drops instead of extending with full inventory.
